brief:
Israeli Occupation Forces killed 25 Palestinians between October 3 and 9, including five children, two women, and a paramedic, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The deaths occurred as Israel continued destroying homes across the Gaza Strip.

The killings represent the latest toll in what the human rights organization characterizes as an ongoing genocidal campaign now in its fourth year.
dek: Between 3 and 9 October 2026, Israeli Occupation Forces (IOF) killed 25 Palestinians, including five children, two women, and a paramedic, according to documentation by field researchers from the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights (PCHR). These crimes are part of Israel’s ongoing genocidal campaign against the Palestinian people, now entering its fourth year.
title: Israeli forces kill 25 Palestinians including five children in Gaza Strip
